data: 3. PRZEGLĄD METOD KOMPENSACJI WPŁYWU TEMPERATURY Z ZASTOSOWANIEM OBWODÓW KOMPENSACJI W ANALOGOWEJ CZĘŚCI UKŁADU PRZETWARZAJĄCEGO
3. REVIEW OF METHODS OF COMPENSATING THE EFFECT OF TEMPERATURE USING COMPENSATION CIRCUITRY IN THE ANALOG PART OF THE SIGNAL-CONDITIONING CIRCUIT
4. A NEW METHOD OF COMPENSATION OF TEMPERATURE ERRORS
6. ZASTOSOWANIE NOWEJ METODY KOMPENSACI W PIEZOREZYSTANCYJNYM PRZETWORNIKU CISNIENIA
6. APPLICATION OF THE NEW COMPENSATION METHOD IN A PIEZORESISTIVE PRESSURE TRANSDUCER
Era-specific unit (PN-74/M-42020 rule). Typeset as %/10 K.
Assumption 4.1 c/: parameter value and temperature error add.
p. 9: the downstream instruments in the control system.
Keep the formula; note that the thesis found it valid only over about 20 K.
Archiwum Elektrotechniki / Biuletyn Mera / WNT / PWN
Journal and publisher names: keep untranslated in the bibliography.
'process instrumentation' in ISA language; keep 'industrial automation' (it is in the company name).
prototype tests / full product qualification tests
Cantilever carrying the two gauges (Fig. 27). 'cantilever beam' acceptable where the mechanics matter.

CONTESTABLE. IEC 60051 calls the error due to an influence quantity a 'variation'; OIML/East-bloc texts 'additional error'; ISA 'influence error'. Keep 'additional error' (matches the PN quotation) and gloss once.
IEC 60051/VIM: error under reference conditions. 'basic error' is the literal East-bloc rendering; use 'intrinsic error' and gloss once.
Error of the transfer characteristic at reference temperature (as opposed to temperature error), p. 48.
ISA-37.1 defines 'temperature error' exactly in this sense (change of output due to temperature). Preferred over 'thermal error'.

CONTESTABLE. VIM: 'maximum permissible error'; PN/IEC: 'limit of error'. The thesis uses it both as a constant bound (Fig. 2a) and as a limiting slope (Fig. 2b, %/10 K). 'error limit' works for both; use 'maximum permissible error' when the PN accuracy-class rule is quoted.
Thesis p. 6: relative = % of span per stated temperature change; absolute = difference of parameter values.
Error due to temperature gradients during ambient changes.
The thesis supplies the English 'temperature decay'. Keep it (with the Polish in a note); modern term would be 'thermal recovery' / 'relaxation'.

Thesis definition p. 9: the relation U = g(X,T) between measurand and output. Alternatives: 'input-output characteristic', 'calibration curve' (ISA). 'transfer function' is reserved for dynamics in English.
PN rule: an additional error must not exceed the next-lower value in the series (e.g. class 0.4 -> 0.25 %/10 K).
p_o in section 3.2; also 'initial pressure' when a reference point is meant.
Pressure at the upper range value.
systematic (repeatable) and random part of the error

The thesis's czujnik is the pressure-sensing assembly (bellows + beam + gauges, or the silicon chip) whose raw output u = f(X,T) is not yet standardized. ISA-37.1 would call this the 'sensing element'; 'sensor' is the modern MEMS term and reads better. Never 'detector' or 'probe'.
'próbkujący' is literally 'sampling' but means 'sensing/picking up' here; do not translate as 'sampling' (DSP connotation).

α_1, the slope of the transfer characteristic (ISA-37.1: ratio of output change to measurand change). 'transfer sensitivity' if the modifier is needed; in ch. 6 the text equates it with gain (wzmocnienie).
Era phrase 'scale length' for a DVM resolution.
'odwzorowanie' = mapping/representation; here the fit of the polynomial.

CONTESTABLE. In the thesis dryft (temperaturowy) means a temperature-induced change, not a change with time. ISA-37.1's terms are 'thermal zero shift' / 'thermal sensitivity shift'; modern data sheets say TCO/TCS. 'zero drift / span drift (with temperature)' is nonetheless common and is used here for readability; add 'temperature' when the Polish has it. Never 'temperature drift' alone without the parameter.
limiting zero drift / limiting span drift
Maximum slope in %/10 K (Figs. 41-43 dashed lines).
dryft szerokości zakresu / dryft rozpiętości zakresu
drift of the lower range value
ISA-37.1: thermal span (sensitivity) shift. Fig. 30 axis 'Dryft zakresu'.
ISA-37.1: thermal zero shift. Fig. 30 axis 'Dryft zera'.
'one-port' in network theory; 'dipole' is a false friend. 'temperature-dependent two-terminal network' for 'dwójnik o rezystancji zależnej od temperatury'; 'network' alone once established.
A potentiometer used as an adjustable divider across a bridge diagonal.
The electronics that process the sensor signal ('signal conditioning' is the ISA term). 'processing circuit' acceptable.
Polish element = circuit component (resistor, thermistor...). Use 'component' for hardware, 'element' for abstract elements (element of a set) and for 'element kompensujący'.
'compensation component' when a physical resistor is meant.
p. 15: the primary element (e.g. a strain gauge) that converts the measurand; ISA-37.1 'sensing element' / 'transduction element'.
One per compensation temperature per parameter (thesis claim).
'monolithic' where the text means on the same chip.
fala prostokątna / prąd o kształcie prostokątnym
Thesis spelling 'Balley' is almost certainly Bailey Meter Co.; ref. [48] is J.C. Martin, 'Silicon pressure transducer circuit'. Keep thesis spelling in the Polish, correct in English with a note.
firma Bell and Howell / Bell Howell, USA
Spelled both ways in the thesis; use 'Bell & Howell'.
Kulite Semiconductor Products; ref. [77]. (Janusz Bryzek later worked there.)
Thesis has the plural; the company is National Semiconductor Corp. Refs. [1,42,70].

CONTESTABLE. f_j(T) in (25)-(27). Literal 'partial function' has a fixed, different meaning in mathematics and collides with 'partial derivative/differential equation' (also cząstkowy in Polish). 'component function' or 'factor function' (they are multiplied) avoids this.
Difference D between divider ratio and a straight line through two temperatures (appendix 9.1).
Polish gałąź = arm (not 'branch'); 'przeciwne gałęzie' = opposite arms.
Transistor T_4 used as on-chip heater.
IAP PW (Institute of Industrial Automation, Warsaw University of Technology)
Expansion inferred (Instytut Automatyki Przemysłowej Politechniki Warszawskiej); the thesis gives only the abbreviation. Method [61] Włodarski & Bryzek.
Z_1 ... Z_12 in the multiple bridge.
Stored in ROM per unit (p. 16, forward-looking remark).
institutions detached from the manufacturing plant
Era/house style: the thesis gives all temperatures in kelvin (253 K-333 K, 293 K), °C only in PN quotations. Keep K; a translator's note may add °C equivalents once.
Extension cable to the potentiometer board outside the chamber.
Thesis classification by degree of the error polynomial, p. 7.
temperature chamber / climatic chamber / variable-temperature chamber
All the same apparatus; 'environmental chamber' in US usage.
Points = temperatures including the reference (p. 36: three-point = two compensation temperatures).
See kompensacja pełna. Thesis definition (p. 58): m·n < s.

CONTESTABLE. Thesis definition: transducer error identically zero over the operating range. 'full compensation' is equally attested; 'complete/incomplete' pairs better than 'full/partial' (partial suggests a fraction, whereas niepełna means fewer compensation temperatures than the polynomial degree).
p. 15 d/: in the digital part of the control system.
Compensation by means of circuitry (as opposed to technological or mechanical).
compensation of the lower / upper range value
compensation of the effect of temperature
Polish mainframe (Elwro, ICL 1900 compatible). Keep name; gloss once.
koszt wytwarzania / cena sprzedażna / cena jednostkowa
manufacturing cost / selling price / unit price
SI already; 20-100 kPa is the pneumatic standard signal (equivalent of 3-15 psi / 0.2-1 bar).
limits of the operating temperature range
'diaphragm' is the pressure-sensor term; 'membrane' is the cognate but reads as biology/chemistry. Patent [9]: 'semiconductor pressure diaphragm'.
Laboratorium Badań Wyrobów Działu Kontroli Jakości
Product Testing Laboratory of the Quality Control Department
literatura patentowa / zgłoszenie patentowe / zastrzeżenia patentowe
patent literature / patent application / patent claims
mała wyższego rzędu / mała drugiego rzędu
quantity of higher (second) order of smallness
Russian-style phrase ('малая высшего порядка'); 'second-order effect' in plain English.
'digital manometer' is also used (TI 'digital quartz manometer' [80]); 'pressure gauge' avoids the liquid-column connotation.
'process fluid' in industrial English; keep 'medium' for fidelity.
Warsaw manufacturer of pneumatic and electronic process instruments (Mera combine). Keep; gloss once as 'Mera-Pnefal, Warsaw'.
One stage M_i of the multiple bridge.
MK_1, MK_2 in ch. 6. Alternative: 'single-stage bridge'.
MP in Fig. 31: the bridge containing the gauges.

CONTESTABLE. Author's coinage: a chain of bridges in which each bridge's output diagonal supplies the next. Options: 'multiple bridge', 'cascaded bridge', 'multi-stage bridge'. 'multiple' preserves jednokrotny/dwukrotny/trójkrotny = single/double/triple, but 'double bridge' collides with the Kelvin double bridge; a translator's note is needed either way.
PN wording; the thesis body uses K.
PN-74/M-42020 method: error limit expressed as a slope per 10 K.
Optimisation criterion in sections 6.4.3-6.4.4 and the appendix; the maximum slope M in %/10 K of the divider nonlinearity vs temperature.
Thesis defines it as measured pressure minus atmospheric. NOT 'overpressure' (which means pressure beyond rating).
Honeywell feature shifting the start point by ±100 % of span; ISA-51.1 'suppressed/elevated zero'.
U_p in section 3.2 (collides with U_p lower-range output elsewhere).
CONTESTABLE but standard Polish EE usage (napięcie sumacyjne = common-mode, napięcie różnicowe = differential). Do not translate literally as 'sum voltage'.
U_z; in the Zener context the breakdown voltage.
ISA-37.1 'excitation'. Plain 'supply voltage' for the 25 V rail.
naprężenie = stress; odkształcenie = strain. The thesis speaks of stresses in the beam; keep 'stress'. ε in the gauge-factor formula is strain.
Pre-stress of the beam at the lower range value.
Position/value of an adjustable element; 'adjustment' as the act.
ISA-37.1 'linearity' is specified as a nonlinearity figure. Keep 'nonlinearity' (unhyphenated).
Permanent change of a parameter after temperature excursions (p. 12).

CONTESTABLE. Key concept: adjusting at temperature T_k does not disturb settings made at T_1 ... T_{k-1} (triangular structure). 'one-way independence' is plainer; 'unidirectional' matches the register of a thesis. Define once and keep.

CONTESTABLE. Bringing the output to a standard signal; 'normalization' is the cognate but in English means scaling to 1. For the block N use 'normalizing circuit'; for the appendix's 'normalizację wyników' use 'normalization' (mathematical).
Ośrodek Badawczo-Rozwojowy Automatyki Przemysłowej (OBRAP / OBR AP) Mera-Pnefal
Mera-Pnefal Industrial Automation Research and Development Centre
Abbreviation appears as both OBRAP and OBR AP.
East-bloc phrasing; English data sheets say 'performance characteristics'. Keep 'metrological' once, then 'performance' where it reads better.
Patent PRL nr ... / Patent USA nr ... / Patent Wielkiej Brytanii nr ...
Polish patent No. ... / US patent No. ... / British patent No. ...
pełny mostek / pół mostka / ćwierć mostka
full bridge / half bridge / quarter bridge
'die' in fab language; 'chip' for a general reader.
Fig. 27: small board to which the gauge leads are soldered.
Polish Standard PN-73/M-42024, Industrial automation - Analogue electrical elements and devices - Requirements and tests
Cited for accuracy-class series and the nonlinearity/temperature-error rule.
Polish Standard PN-74/M-42020, National System of Automation and Measurement POLMATIK - General requirements and tests
Cited for the rule: additional errors specified per 10 °C of ambient/medium temperature change. Keep the PN number; translate the title once.

Era/Polish product category: input is the pneumatic standard signal 20-100 kPa, output an electric standard signal. 'pneumo-electric converter' also seen; avoid 'P/E converter' (too terse for a keepsake).
Name of the Polish national automation and measurement system; keep.
Title term. Thesis definition p. 9-10: transducer whose sensor is built from semiconductor elements and converts gauge pressure to a standardized electrical signal.
p. 6: literally 'copyright', but the sense is protection of the maker's IP on the market.
'behaviour', 'shape' or 'variation with temperature' by context; Fig. 23 'schematyczny przebieg' = schematic shape.

CONTESTABLE. 'napięcie na przekątnej mostka' = 'bridge output voltage' is idiomatic; keep 'output diagonal' where the geometry matters (e.g. the next bridge is supplied from the diagonal). ISA/W&H use 'output terminals'.
Honeywell circuit: coarse offset by a resistive divider, fine by potentiometer.

Polysemous. Default 'transducer' (sensor + conditioning electronics with a standardized output; the 1970s semiconductor-sensor literature and the cited US patents say 'pressure transducer'). In process-instrumentation English a device with a 4-20 mA output is a 'transmitter' (IEC 60770); use 'transmitter' only where the text stresses the industrial product (A271/A272, 'przetwornik międzysystemowy'). 'converter' only for 'przetwornik analogowo-cyfrowy'.
Mera 'Eftronik' product class (type A271): converts between the pneumatic and electric signal systems. Keep the literal rendering; explain once in a translator's note.
Thesis definition (p. 9): sensor + electronic conditioning circuit that brings the output to a standard signal. Often just 'transducer' once established.
Mera-Pnefal product designations; keep as is.

East-bloc textbook phrase ('преобразователь неэлектрических величин'). Idiomatic English would be 'transducer for physical quantities', but keep the literal form; it is the thesis's own generalisation.
Unstrained resistance at reference temperature; 'nominal resistance' where a catalogue value is meant.
As temperature sensors (copper, approx. 2 %/10 K): 'metal resistance elements'.
Federal Republic of Germany / USSR / Polish People's Republic / United Kingdom
Synonym of szerokość zakresu; used in ch. 6 (rozpiętość zakresu 80 kPa).
'detuning' is a false friend for rozstrojenie here.
Unit-to-unit variation of a parameter; 'scatter' for the plotted cloud (Fig. 30 'Rozrzut').
'solution' only for equations; 'znane rozwiązania kompensacji' = known compensation schemes/designs.
'circuit solution' is a calque; 'rozwiązania kompensacji' = compensation schemes.
Gauges in adjacent arms with opposite strain.
'schematic' (US). Fig. 39 'uproszczony schemat ideowy' = simplified circuit diagram.
'null' where a bridge/potentiometer adjustment is meant.
Of a resistor: low temperature coefficient.
Section 6.2. 10-50 mA and 0-50 mA are era signals.
Output change over the span; 'span signal' acceptable.
sygnały prądowe 0...6 mA, 4...20 mA; napięciowe 1...5 V
current signals 0-6 mA, 4-20 mA; voltage signals 1-5 V
Footnote p. 9. '0...6 mA' as printed (0-5 mA elsewhere in the thesis); do not silently correct.
ISA-51.1: span = algebraic difference between upper and lower range values. The thesis uses szerokość and rozpiętość synonymously.
T_1 ... T_n; thesis coinage, keep literal.

British spelling 'gauge' chosen for the whole translation; US patents in the bibliography spell 'gage'. Keep bibliography titles verbatim. The thesis uses tensometr for both bonded silicon gauges (ch. 6) and diffused piezoresistors (ch. 3); see tensorezystor.
Calque of Russian тензорезистор. Used for resistors diffused into a silicon diaphragm; the MEMS term is 'piezoresistor' (or 'diffused resistor'). Not 'tensoresistor'.
Honeywell circuit: diffused resistors that respond to temperature but not pressure; a 'dummy gauge' in strain-gauge language.
NTC110 type (Polish NTC thermistor); keep type designations.
Keeping the sensor at constant temperature so that compensation is unnecessary.
reducing the error identically to zero
Central claim: Δ(T) ≡ 0 over the whole temperature range.
T_1 ... T_4 in figures (collides with temperatures T_1 ...).
Used for 'zera' and 'zakresu'; in English the quotation marks alone usually suffice.

Highly polysemous: układ elektroniczny = electronic circuit; układ blokowy = block diagram; układ pomiarowy = measuring setup; układ regulacji = control system; rozwiązanie układowe = circuit design. Choose by collocation.
Keep the thesis's quoted 'n·V_BE' and gloss as V_BE multiplier.
układ kompensacji / układ kompensacyjny / układ kompensujący
Block N, Fig. 15, coefficients b_1, b_2, b_3. Functionally a signal conditioner.
Figs. 28 and 40: the test bench. 'measuring circuit' when it is a circuit.
układ W przetwarzający różnicę napięć na prąd wyjściowy
p. 85, in quotation marks in the thesis.
Very frequent; 'versus temperature' in figure captions.
'% FS' in data sheets; keep '% of span' in prose.
ISA-51.1 'upper range-value'; 'full scale' in sensor data sheets. Symbol X_k / U_k.
ISA-51.1 'lower range-value'. The thesis identifies it with 'zero' (tzw. 'zera'); in prose 'zero' is fine once the equivalence has been stated. Symbol X_p (measurand) / U_p (output).
degree of freedom / degrees of freedom
p. 79/109: 'ciekawsze węzły przetwornika' = the more interesting subassemblies (functional blocks).
ISA-37.1/VIM term; 'measured quantity' in plain prose. X in the thesis.
The thesis uses stopień and rząd (order) interchangeably for polynomials; English prefers 'degree'. Keep 'order' only for 'krzywa czwartego rzędu' (fourth-order curve) if desired.
connected in series / in parallel / in series-parallel
'influence of temperature' in the title context; 'temperature effects' in prose.
WD = U_AB/U_DB. 'dzielnikowanie' is a coinage; 'divider ratio' also fine.
Gain of block W (voltage-difference to current).
TCR; β_p, β_z for junction voltages.
Differential connection of the two gauges in the bridge.
Literally 'current capacity'; means the current the source delivers.
Time in the chamber for the temperature to settle (approx. 1.5 h). Not 'annealing', not 'burn-in'.
wzajemne uzależnienie (nastaw / kompensacji zera i zakresu)
Instrumentation idiom: 'zero-span interaction'. For settings at different temperatures: 'mutual dependence of the settings'.
Fig. 40 item V: a precision pneumatic regulator used to set input pressure.

CONTESTABLE. When the thesis says 'kompensacja zakresu', 'dryft zakresu', 'błąd temperaturowy zakresu' it means the upper-range-value / span parameter, not the measuring range. Render as 'span' (ISA 'thermal span shift'). p. 11 note: the thesis distinguishes b/ error of the upper value X_k and c/ error of span; both are 'span' in data-sheet English.
ISA-51.1 'range'. Do not use 'span' here; span is szerokość/rozpiętość zakresu.
Polish uses zależność for any formula; render as 'relation', 'expression' or 'equation (n)' according to context; 'dependence' when a functional dependence is meant.
Numbered displays are cited as 'zależność (12)' etc.
Error of the conditioning electronics referred to the sensor and added to the sensor's own error (p. 10). 'referred to the sensor' is the EE idiom (cf. 'referred to input').
Output at the lower range value; 'zero' / 'zero point' / 'offset' (MEMS: offset). Keep 'zero' to match 'zero drift', 'zeroing'.
zerowanie mostka = balancing (nulling) the bridge; zerowanie przetwornika = zero adjustment; zerowanie błędu = nulling the error. Choose by object.
e.g. zespół mieszka; 'main units' of the transducer (p. 88).
National Semiconductor / Honeywell diffused-silicon sensors with on-chip electronics.
Same Polish word as junction; on p. 102 it is the plug/socket to the potentiometer board.
Diodes and transistors used as temperature sensors (section 3.4).
IEC 60381 standard signals: 4-20 mA, 0-20 mA, 1-5 V etc.
Use the Ω sign in the translation; 'ułamków omów' = fractions of an ohm.
